title: Understanding Angular Momentum
text: Angular momentum $$L$$ is given by the formula $$L=rp\sin(\theta)$$, $$where$$ $$r$$ is the radius vector, $$p$$ is the linear momentum, and $$\theta$$ is the angle between $$r$$ and $$p$$.

title: Calculate Linear Momentum
text: The linear momentum $$p$$ of the bird is given by $$p=mv$$, $$where$$ $$\, \text{m$$} $$is$$ $$the$$ $$mass$$ $$and$$ $$v$$ is the velocity of the bird.

title: Calculate Linear Momentum
text: Given the mass of the bird is $$2.0\, \text{kg}$$ and its velocity is $$20.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$, $$calculate$$ $$the$$ $$linear$$ $$momentum$$.

title: Determine the Radius Vector
text: The radius vector $$r$$ is the distance from the point where you are standing to the bird. Given the altitude of the bird is $$300.0\, \text{m}$$, $$use$$ $$trigonometry$$ $$to$$ $$find$$ $$r$$.

title: Calculate Radius Vector
text: Assuming the bird is directly overhead, the radius vector is equal to the altitude. Calculate $$r$$.
